original.text: ★박사 예비심사 자격: 박사 논문제출자격시험에 합격한 자
★박사 예비심사는 초심/ 종심 이전 학기까지 완료해야 함
예) 2026년 2학기에 초심, 종심을 보고 27년 2월 박사 학위수여 예정자의 경우,

가. 위원위촉보고서 작성 시, 서울대학교 소속 교수는 모두 내부위원으로 간주합니다.
* 참고: 다음 학기에는(논문심사 종심 진행) 2명의 심사위원이 추가되어, 심사위원은 5명이고 지도교수가 부위원장이 됩니다.

rows:

original.text: 다. ‘국제학술지 게재확인서’는 게재한 학생과 아직 게재하지 못한 학생 모두 제출해야 합니다.
아직 게재하지 못한 학생은 양식 하단의 ‘논문이 게재되지 않은 경우’ 란에 지도교수 서명(또는 날인) 포함하여 제출 바랍니다.
라. 예심은 심사료 납부 및 온라인 접수가 없습니다.
마. 국제학술지 실적이 있는 경우, 실적 1건만 작성 및 제출 바랍니다.
가. 1, 2항 설명: 이번학기 논문심사 심사일정 안내 게시글 참고

english: ★ Eligibility for the doctoral 예비심사 (preliminary thesis review): students who have passed the doctoral 논문제출자격시험 (thesis qualifying exam)
★ The doctoral preliminary review must be completed by the semester before the 초심 (first thesis review) / 종심 (final thesis review)
e.g.) If you will take the first and final thesis reviews in the 2nd semester of 2026 and expect to receive your doctoral degree in Feb 2027,
you must complete the preliminary review by the 1st semester of 2026.
1. Eligible students: students expected to receive a doctoral degree in Feb 2027 (graduating in Feb 2027)
2. Documents to submit
A. [Attachment 01] 위원위촉보고서 (Committee Member Appointment Report): 13 Apr 2026 (Mon) ~ 27 Apr 2026 (Mon)
B. [Attachment 02] 논문지도결과보고서 (Thesis Supervision Result Report) and 국제학술지게재확인서 (Confirmation of International Journal Publication): 15 Jun 2026 ~ 27 Jul 2026
★ If you have an international journal publication, also submit document ③. If you have no publication, submit only documents ①~②.
※ Documents 1~3: Please submit them in the order below.
① Thesis Supervision Result Report
② Confirmation of International Journal Publication
③ (Only if applicable) A copy of the first page of the paper ※ Highlighting is required: your name / your advisor's name / the name of the journal (or conference)
3. Where to submit: Department Administration Office (Building 301, Room 319) / 이소연 (Lee So-yeon)
4. Notes
A. When filling in the Committee Member Appointment Report, all professors affiliated with Seoul National University are regarded as internal members.
B. In the preliminary review, the committee chair is the advisor.
* Note: In the next semester (when the final thesis review takes place), 2 more committee members are added, so there will be 5 committee members and the advisor becomes the vice-chair.

★ Committee member qualifications
∙ Full-time faculty, endowed-fund faculty, HK faculty, and non-full-time faculty of SNU
∙ Experts from outside SNU who hold a doctoral degree and meet one of the items below
㈀ Faculty of another university: assistant professor or higher
㈁ Researcher at a research institute: has worked in a research field for 2 years or more after obtaining a doctoral degree
※ It is fine to appoint external members
※ SNU professors emeriti may also be appointed as committee members
C. The 'Confirmation of International Journal Publication' must be submitted by all students, both those who have published and those who have not yet published.
Students who have not yet published must fill in the 'If the paper has not been published' section at the bottom of the form, including the advisor's signature (or 날인 (seal)), and submit it.
D. For the preliminary review, there is no review fee payment and no online application.
E. If you have international journal publications, please fill in and submit only 1 publication.
5. Reference
① Requirements for awarding the doctoral degree (related to publications)
A. Explanation of items 1 and 2: refer to the post announcing this semester's thesis review schedule
B. Notice on the "List of conferences recognized as equivalent to international journals (SCI(E))": related notice - Click!!
C. Notice on whether co-first authorship is recognized: related notice - Click!!
